patches.rule: If study_design_type differs by more than 1 category, route to partial not genuine

Do NOT emit single-paper-limitation gaps: reformatting one paper's Limitations section into a 'gap' (tier=derived, single claiming paper, boilerplate closure 'Requires follow-up validated study addressing this limitation') captures a study weakness, not a corpus-level gap. Only emit a gap where >=2-3 papers converge on a genuine cross-paper absence with specific, testable closure criteria (cf. curated ACTOR G-010..015). Generator disabled in agent4_relational.py (~line 2580); _auto_reject_single_paper_limitation_gaps() auto-rejects strays each run, protecting human_curated records.
